In conformity with PRM 1.6.4R, Pennon Group plc notifies the market that ordinary shares of 61.05 pence each ('Ordinary Shares') have been admitted to trading as set out in the table below. The Ordinary Shares have been admitted to trading under existing block listing admissions of Ordinary Shares in connection with the Pennon Group plc Save As You Earn (SAYE) scheme.
